categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Beat the game (clear light Dr. Fetus) from a new save.

- Time starts on "Start Game" and ends on the first all-white frame of the final cutscene. 
- If your run is better than 18m30s you have to stream your attempts or provide video proof of your attempts in some other form, or your run will be rejected.

Complete every level and collect all 100 bandages from a new save. 

- Time starts on "Start Game" and ends on either the first all-white frame of the final cutscene or returning to menu upon completing the last level needed for 106%.

categories.name: Dark Ending
categories.rules:
Reach the dark ending (clear dark Dr. Fetus) from a new save.

- Time starts on "Start Game" and ends on the first all-white frame of the final cutscene.
- Unlocking dark fetus by switching to dark world after completing all light levels in light end is not allowed

categories.name: Any% (Major Glitches)
categories.rules:
Beat the game (clear light Dr. Fetus) from a new save. 

Time starts on "Start Game" and ends on the first all-white frame of the final cutscene.

categories.name: All Light Levels
categories.rules:
Complete all light non-warpzone levels in the game (including bosses) from a new save.

- Time starts on "Start Game" and ends upon completing 7-20.

categories.name: All Dark Levels
categories.rules:
Complete every non-warpzone dark level in the game, including Dark Dr. Fetus.

Time starts on "Start Game" and ends when the final level is beaten.

levels.name: Light Forest
levels.rules:
- Submit your runs as using clips if at any point you pass through a solid object. All runs using Steve, Meat Ninja, or Dr. Fetus must be submitted as using clips.
- Game fps must be a stable 60 fps. Any benefit from abnormal fps is banned (including clipping through walls from lag, even though other kinds of clips are allowed). Videos should be at least 30 fps.
- Dr. Fetus and Potato Boy are normally unplayable as characters, but may be used if accessed through the bandage duplication glitch.

FOR INDIVIDUAL LEVEL RUNS:
- The video must include the actual level being played from start to finish, including spawn frame and timer disappear. Replays will not be accepted.
- Using level-to-level storage of character state is banned, including (but not limited to) storage jumps, instaflips with Captain Viridian, and delaying cycles with character unlocks or similar.
- Autojump and pausing are banned.
- Times with a hundredth decimal of 1, 4, 6, or 9 will be rounded up as they only appear if there is lag, potentially giving a slight advantage as lag can make characters move faster.

FOR INDIVIDUAL WORLD RUNS:
- Runs begin at character select on the first level of a chapter and end upon reaching bandage girl at the end of the 20th level. Do not include bosses in your attempts.
- Autojump and pausing are allowed. Storage is also allowed, provided the storage is not obtained before the start of the run.

Yeaaaaaaaaaaah! I got it!
This is a very good run for me. A lot a tiny mistakes make this run just very good and not excelent. But I'm still fine with a "very good" run because even that is very difficult to get aha!
So the factory was very sloppy, I missed a lot of strat and did a lot of mistakes but I didn't die.
I caught up the time I lost in factory in hell. Someone called me on my phone on the 4-18 that's why I forgot to get out of the lvl.
At this point I knew rapture would determine the destiny of this run. And I got a clean rapture with not a lot of risky strat indeed (my safe routing by skipping the 5-1 for example). And at the end of rapture I thought "well this is actually very good for now" at this moment the pressure started to come.
At larries I was perfectly calm, I knew he was gonna troll me again and it turns out I was wrong and gave me a 4 cycles! Thank you larries! And then I thought "Ok now I'm gonna screw up the end". 
This end was very sloppy because of the intense pressure, no fast strat here neither, I wanted to play very safe and I did. 

I still can't believe that I got a deathless sub 18:30 run x) The better thing I hopped to get was a sub exo and now I have a sub 18:30. I fell obviously very happy about that, and I think I'm done with this category for a very long time.

PS: The final time is not 18:27:82 but 18:27:92, I splitted a bit early on the run, too excited lol

Enjoy that 60fps footage :p

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Beat the game (clear light Dr. Fetus) from a new save.

- Time starts on "Start Game" and ends on the first all-white frame of the final cutscene. 
- If your run is better than 18m30s you have to stream your attempts or provide video proof of your attempts in some other form, or your run will be rejected.

games.name: Super Meat Boy
games.rules:
- Alt glitch, replay glitch, and bandage duping are banned unless stated otherwise in the category rules.
- Game fps must be a stable 60 fps. Any benefit from abnormal fps (clipping through walls, etc) is banned. Videos should be at least 30 fps. 
- Runs must have audible in-game sound effects (in-game music optional).
- Loading icons and the in game timer must be visible throughout the run.

levels.name: Dark Hospital
levels.rules:
- Submit your runs as using clips if at any point you pass through a solid object. All runs using Steve, Meat Ninja, or Dr. Fetus must be submitted as using clips.
- Game fps must be a stable 60 fps. Any benefit from abnormal fps is banned (including clipping through walls from lag, even though other kinds of clips are allowed). Videos should be at least 30 fps.
- Dr. Fetus and Potato Boy are normally unplayable as characters, but may be used if accessed through the bandage duplication glitch.

FOR INDIVIDUAL LEVEL RUNS:
- The video must include the actual level being played from start to finish, including spawn frame and timer disappear. Replays will not be accepted.
- Using level-to-level storage of character state is banned, including (but not limited to) storage jumps, instaflips with Captain Viridian, and delaying cycles with character unlocks or similar.
- Autojump and pausing are banned.
- Times with a hundredth decimal of 1, 4, 6, or 9 will be rounded up as they only appear if there is lag, potentially giving a slight advantage as lag can make characters move faster.

FOR INDIVIDUAL WORLD RUNS:
- Runs begin at character select on the first level of a chapter and end upon reaching bandage girl at the end of the 20th level. Do not include bosses in your attempts.
- Autojump and pausing are allowed. Storage is also allowed, provided the storage is not obtained before the start of the run.

runs.comment: How ironic is it that the very level I make my first move on when I return for real in September is the very same one that I also manage to cook up a quick and easy 8.4 second improvement when I only come back in March for a marathon. This level has always been on the weaker end of my IWs, and that still may be the case, but it sure does feel a lot closer to the rest of the pack now!

- The use of alt glitch is banned in this category.
